node.title: Re^3: Running tests on modules generated by Module::Starter still in /lib directory
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [nysus],

Did you try what [choroba] [id://1181844|suggested]? The way I run my tests for all my (pure-Perl) modules is prove -l from the command line from the base directory of the module. make should not be necessary unless you've got XS code that you need to compile, but even then, [doc://prove] should be able to run all the tests (AFAIK you need prove -lb in that case).

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
